case.pattern_description: The pattern involves multiple customers' cards being used for online purchases of product C from the same Android device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) within a short window (15 Nov, 26 Nov 2016), resulting in three fraudulent transactions on card C13487-K1 totaling $439.61. It affects debit-card holders whose cards share this rare device fingerprint, which has appeared on only 52 cards but generated 60 purchases across 28 customers and is linked to four prior confirmed-fraud cases. The activity was uncovered after an analyst flagged the device profile as unusual and requested a review of transaction 3478561.

case.summary: The alert was triggered by an analyst request to review transaction 3478561 on card C13487-K1 because several cards this month showed purchases from the same unusual device profile. The strongest findings are that the device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080 has been seen on only 52 cards ever yet made 60 purchases on 28 different customers' cards within 19 days, is 100 % new, always behind an anonymous proxy, and appears in four confirmed-fraud closed cases, while the model risk score of 0.05 for product C transactions corresponds to a calibrated fraud rate of 3 % in the relevant period. The case is judged fraud with a probability of 0.97. The recommended actions are to block the card, create a new case, file a report, monitor the connected cards, and escalate the matter to an analyst.

sar.narrative: The cardholder identified by customer_id C13487 and card_id C13487-K1, a Mastercard debit, was the victim of unauthorized activity. Three online purchases of product code C were made from device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080 in billing region 191. The first transaction, id 3460634 for $112.37, occurred on 2016-11-15 at 20:30; the second, flagged transaction id 3478561 for $74.96, occurred on 2016-11-22 at 16:11; and the third, id 3489320 for $252.28, occurred on 2016-11-26 at 17:39. All three purchases were conducted online using the same device profile that has been observed on only 52 cards and linked to 60 purchases across 28 different customers within 19 days, all marked New and behind an anonymous proxy. The device profile also appears in four confirmed-fraud closed cases (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, CC-3035) and is labeled as undocumented by analysts. The pattern matches none of the documented fraud typologies, indicating an undocumented device_ring scheme. The unauthorized use is suspicious because the same device was used across multiple cards, including the subject's, suggesting a coordinated fraud operation. The cardholder has not yet been contacted, and the card was blocked while connected cards are being monitored.
